q: As of January 15, 2027, Ministry of Commerce Announcements Nos. 55–58, 61, and 62 of 2025 (the October 2025 expansion of rare-earth export controls) remain suspended or have been withdrawn (as confirmed by a Ministry of Commerce announcement or a joint U.S.-China announcement)
basis: The U.S.-China summit in September extended the tariff truce to January 10, 2027. China's rare-earth export controls deter most when held in reserve rather than actually used. Under the ministry's notices, however, the suspension expires on November 10, 2026, and no notice extending it has yet been confirmed. · AI and Chips issue
rs: A Ministry of Commerce notice or a joint U.S.-China announcement
